pole_a.label: object
sentences: We build software our customers rely on every day.
Our job is to ship good products and solve real problems for the people who use them.
We measure success by whether the product works for the customer in front of us.
We're heads-down on the craft of the work itself.
We serve our clients and deliver what we promised them.
What matters is the quality of what we make and the people we make it for.
We focus on the end user and the problem they need solved.
Our attention is on the product, the code, and the customer.

pole_b.label: meta
sentences: We are a model for how every company could work.
Our real product is our method, and we share it with the world.
We teach other organizations our methodology so they can transform themselves.
What we've built is a movement, and we measure our impact in how far it spreads.
We exist to be an example that other organizations can follow.
Our culture is the thing others come to learn and take home with them.
We're spreading a philosophy, not just running a business.
Our influence is in how many organizations adopt what we've pioneered.
